_doc: LZ tracking geometry, schema v3. This file promotes the fast-kernel detector partition into the canonical tracking geometry. Source geometry remains separate. z=0 is the cathode. TPC drifts upward (z>0). All dimensions in cm.
name: LZ

volumes._doc: Top-level runtime tracking envelope matching the inner ICV cavity to first order.
volumes.name: LZ_detector

volumes._doc: Gas dome matching the ICV top inner surface. Equator at z=148.5 (ICV_top equator), R=82.1 (ICV inner R with uniform 0.9 cm wall). The real ICV is not a perfect dome; this is a deliberate simplification so that the tracking detector boundary coincides with the ICV inner surface.
volumes.name: AirDome

volumes._doc: Cylindrical gas gap between the gate plane (z=145.6) and the AirDome equator (z=148.5). Fills the region inside the ICV barrel above the LXe surface.
volumes.name: AirCyl

volumes._doc: Passive LXe ellipsoidal cap forming the bottom dome of the detector envelope. R=82.1 cm, z=[-68.70, -41.33], aspect=3.0. No inner region occupies this volume.
volumes.name: LXe_dome

volumes._doc: Passive LXe disk between the bottom dome equator and the bottom of the field-cage envelope. R<=82.1 cm, z=[-41.33, -13.75].
volumes.name: LXe_below_FC

volumes._doc: Passive LXe in the central column between the field-cage bottom (z=-13.75) and the cathode plane (z=0). R<=72.8 cm. This is the volume bottom-PMT gammas traverse before entering BottomActive.
volumes.name: LXe_below_cathode

volumes._doc: Active Xe above the FV, from z=96 to the gate plane z=145.6.
volumes.name: TopActive

volumes._doc: Active Xe barrel shell around the FV, spanning the same z interval as the FV.
volumes.name: BarrelActive

volumes._doc: Active Xe below the FV, from the cathode plane z=0 up to the FV bottom at z=26.
volumes.name: BottomActive

volumes._doc: Fiducial volume: R=39.0, z=[26.0, 96.0], center z=61.0.
volumes.name: FV

volumes._doc: Field cage PTFE shell: R=[72.8, 73.947], z=[-13.75, 145.6]. Anatomical dimensions matching the source-side volume — wall thickness back-derived from bb0nu 184 kg over the full FC envelope (drift + RFR), so tracking and source share dimensions.
volumes.name: FC_PTFE

volumes._doc: Field-cage Ti rings shell: R=[73.947, 74.224], z=[-13.75, 145.6]. Inner radius is the outer wall of FC_PTFE so the two effective field-cage layers touch (no LXe sliver between them). Wall thickness 0.277 cm unchanged — bb0nu 93 kg preserved.
volumes.name: FC_rings

volumes._doc: LXe skin veto region outside the field cage: R=[74.224, 82.1], z=[-13.75, 145.6]. Inner radius is the outer wall of FC_rings (the radial chain BarrelActive -> FC_PTFE -> FC_rings -> Skin is contiguous, no LXe gaps). Wall thickness grows by 0.353 cm to keep the outer surface at the envelope radius 82.1. Below z=-13.75 the dome region is bare passive LXe.
volumes.name: Skin
